name: Racing Results
description: Gathers and displays the latest Formula 1, IndyCar and NASCAR results and standings in the FPP web UI.

privacy.summary: Asks Jolpica F1 and ESPN's public score API for race results. Keeps nothing but your own settings and a local cache.

sends.what: a request for the current Formula 1 season's latest results and standings
a request for the scoreboard of each IndyCar or NASCAR series you enable
